records.title: From Coordinates to Candidate Regions: Temporal Change Localization via Region Selection in Remote Sensing Multimodal LLMs
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes region-selection output for remote-sensing localization; its contribution is task formulation/training and localization quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract focuses on cyber-model post-training data collection, teacher sampling and trajectory quality; the cost discussion is training/data generation, not deployed inference.

records.title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
records.reason: The abstract concerns long-sequence recommendation modeling and low-rank caching; it does not describe an LLM or LLM serving/inference method.

records.title: CreaMem: A Scene-Aware Memory Architecture for Personalized Agents
records.reason: It is an agent-memory quality architecture with higher measured query latency, not an inference-efficiency improvement; the abstract’s retrieval-space reduction does not translate to demonstrated runtime savings.

records.title: Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes biometric-gated personalized memory retrieval for shared agents, with owner-separation accuracy as the outcome; it does not address inference cost or latency.
